description: This file contains utility functions and classes related to accounting operations in the ERPNext system, including fiscal year handling, balance calculations, GL entry management, account and report utilities, and integrations with other modules like stock management.

classes.name: StockValueAndAccountBalanceOutOfSync
classes.description: Validation error class indicating stock and account balances are out of sync.

classes.name: FiscalYearError
classes.description: Validation error class for errors related to fiscal year handling.

classes.name: PaymentEntryUnlinkError
classes.description: Error class for issues encountered during payment entry unlinking process.

methods.name: get_fiscal_year(date=None, fiscal_year=None, label="Date", verbose=1, company=None, as_dict=False)
methods.description: Returns the fiscal year details for a given date or fiscal year name.

methods.name: get_fiscal_years(transaction_date=None, fiscal_year=None, label="Date", verbose=1, company=None, as_dict=False)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of fiscal years, optionally matching specific transaction date or fiscal year.

methods.name: get_fiscal_year_filter_field(company=None)
methods.description: Provides a filter field for selecting fiscal years, formatted for UI integration.

methods.name: validate_fiscal_year(date, fiscal_year, company, label="Date", doc=None)
methods.description: Validates if a date falls within the specified fiscal year.

methods.name: get_balance_on(account=None, date=None, party_type=None, party=None, company=None, in_account_currency=True, cost_center=None, ignore_account_permission=False)
methods.description: Calculates the balance of an account as of a specific date, optionally filtered by party and company.

methods.name: get_count_on(account, fieldname, date)
methods.description: Counts GL entries linked to an account up to a specified date, with optional filtering.

methods.name: add_ac(args=None)
methods.description: Creates a new account node in the account tree, optionally ignoring permissions.

methods.name: add_cc(args=None)
methods.description: Creates a new cost center node, structured as a tree.

methods.name: reconcile_against_document(args)
methods.description: Handles cancellation and re-application of GL entries against a document, like PE or JV.

methods.name: check_if_advance_entry_modified(args)
methods.description: Checks if a payment or journal entry has been modified after being pulled for reconciliation.

methods.name: validate_allocated_amount(args)
methods.description: Ensures allocated amounts are not negative or exceeding unadjusted amounts.

methods.name: update_reference_in_journal_entry(d, journal_entry, do_not_save=False)
methods.description: Updates references and splits in a journal entry's accounts.

methods.name: update_reference_in_payment_entry(d, payment_entry, do_not_save=False)
methods.description: Updates references in payment entries, creating new reference rows as needed.

methods.name: unlink_ref_doc_from_payment_entries(ref_doc)
methods.description: Removes links between reference documents and payment entries, resetting relevant fields.

methods.name: remove_ref_doc_link_from_jv(ref_type, ref_no)
methods.description: Unlinks reference documents from journal entries.

methods.name: remove_ref_doc_link_from_pe(ref_type, ref_no)
methods.description: Unlinks reference documents from payment entries.

methods.name: get_company_default(company, fieldname, ignore_validation=False)
methods.description: Fetches default company settings for specific fields, with optional validation.

methods.name: fix_total_debit_credit()
methods.description: Rectifies GL entries where debit and credit sums are unbalanced.

methods.name: get_currency_precision()
methods.description: Determines the precision for currency calculations based on system settings.

methods.name: get_stock_rbnb_difference(posting_date, company)
methods.description: Calculates the difference between stock received but not billed and system stock balance.

methods.name: get_held_invoices(party_type, party)
methods.description: Lists invoices that are currently on hold for a customer or supplier.

methods.name: get_outstanding_invoices(party_type, party, account, condition=None, filters=None)
methods.description: Compiles a list of open, unpaid invoices for a party, with filtering capabilities.

methods.name: get_account_name(account_type=None, root_type=None, is_group=None, account_currency=None, company=None)
methods.description: Retrieves an account name based on specific filters like type, currency, and company.

methods.name: get_companies()
methods.description: Returns a list of companies accessible based on user permissions.

methods.name: get_children(doctype, parent, company, is_root=False)
methods.description: Fetches hierarchical child accounts or entities for tree views.

methods.name: get_account_balances(accounts, company)
methods.description: Fetches balances for multiple accounts, optionally in different currencies.

methods.name: create_payment_gateway_account(gateway, payment_channel="Email")
methods.description: Creates and links a payment gateway account for online payment integration.

methods.name: update_cost_center(docname, cost_center_name, cost_center_number, company, merge)
methods.description: Renames and merges cost centers, updating linked documents accordingly.

methods.name: validate_field_number(doctype_name, docname, number_value, company, field_name)
methods.description: Checks for duplicate numbers assigned to documents within a doctype.

methods.name: get_autoname_with_number(number_value, doc_title, name, company)
methods.description: Generates a standardized name for a document incorporating number and company info.

methods.name: get_coa(doctype, parent, is_root, chart=None)
methods.description: Builds or fetches a chart of accounts as a hierarchical JSON structure.

methods.name: update_gl_entries_after(posting_date, posting_time, for_warehouses=None, for_items=None, warehouse_account=None, company=None)
methods.description: Recreates GL entries after stock or account adjustments posted on a date.

methods.name: repost_gle_for_stock_vouchers(stock_vouchers, posting_date, company=None, warehouse_account=None)
methods.description: Replaces existing GL entries with updated entries for stock voucher adjustments.

methods.name: get_future_stock_vouchers(posting_date, posting_time, for_warehouses=None, for_items=None, company=None)
methods.description: Lists upcoming stock vouchers to process for a given date and time.

methods.name: get_voucherwise_gl_entries(future_stock_vouchers, posting_date)
methods.description: Fetches GL entries grouped by voucher for comparison during reposts.

methods.name: compare_existing_and_expected_gle(existing_gle, expected_gle, precision)
methods.description: Compares current GL entries against expected entries for consistency.

methods.name: check_if_stock_and_account_balance_synced(posting_date, company, voucher_type=None, voucher_no=None)
methods.description: Validates that stock and account balances are in sync, triggering correction if not.

methods.name: get_stock_accounts(company, voucher_type=None, voucher_no=None)
methods.description: Returns list of stock-related accounts, optionally filtered by voucher.

methods.name: get_stock_and_account_balance(account=None, posting_date=None, company=None)
methods.description: Gets combined account and stock value balances for an account.

methods.name: get_journal_entry(account, stock_adjustment_account, amount)
methods.description: Constructs journal entry account lines for stock adjustments.

methods.name: check_and_delete_linked_reports(report)
methods.description: Removes desktop icon links that reference specific reports.

methods.name: _delete_gl_entries(voucher_type, voucher_no)
methods.description: unavailable
